name: iqdeal
caption:
WORTH IT? 🎮🏀 We gave Immanuel Quickley $175 million. Then he played 33 games.

• July 2024: we re-sign him for 5 years, $175M
• 2024-25: injuries and a minutes limit, only 33 games
• Jan 2026: 40 points on 11-of-13 shooting against the Warriors
• First 10 games this season: 17.6 PPG, 5.6 APG

Is he worth $175M? 👇

beats.head: THE DEAL
beats.name: QUICKLEY
beats.vo: We gave Immanuel Quickley a five-year, one hundred seventy-five million dollar contract.

beats.head: YEAR ONE
beats.name: QUICKLEY
beats.vo: Year one of the deal? Injuries, a minutes limit, and just thirty-three games.

beats.head: 40 ON 11-OF-13
beats.name: QUICKLEY
beats.vo: Then January twenty twenty-six: forty points on eleven of thirteen shooting against the Warriors. Called the most efficient forty-point game ever.

beats.head: THIS SEASON
beats.name: QUICKLEY
beats.vo: And through ten games this season: seventeen point six points and five point six assists a night.

beats.head: WORTH IT?
beats.vo: A hundred seventy-five million dollars. Is he worth it? Comment below.

facts.claim: July 8, 2024: Quickley re-signed with the Raptors on a 5-year, $175 million contract; in 2024-25 he struggled with injuries, played only 33 games, often on a minutes restriction; January 20, 2026: 40 points (tying his career high) on 11-of-13 shooting in a 145-127 win over the Golden State Warriors, described as the most efficient 40-point game in league history
